title: Luno cuts 20% of staff as crypto layoffs spread across 12 firms in July
summary: Luno and Gnosis joined a widening round of crypto restructurings in July, when at least 12 companies reported job cuts.

title: Japanese game developer launches Bitcoin, altcoin fund with SBI
summary: The Bitcoin and altcoin fund builds on Gumi’s growing crypto business centered around XRP, with the company nearly doubling its crypto holdings over the past year.

title: Ethereum Foundation adds SEAL 911 co-founder to board as privacy focus grows
summary: Pascal Caversaccio joins the Ethereum Foundation’s four-member board as the organization elevates privacy and security in its protocol strategy.

title: US arbitration giant launches specialist panel for crypto disputes
summary: The American Arbitration Association’s Web3 Panel brings together specialists in blockchain, smart contracts, digital assets and autonomous transactions.

title: Robinhood posts record quarter, but crypto revenue slides 38%
summary: The online brokerage continued expanding its digital asset business with Robinhood Chain, tokenized stocks and decentralized lending even as cryptocurrency transaction revenue declined.

title: Binance.US to attempt prediction markets entry as CFTC-licensed entity, says CEO
summary: The CEO of the US crypto exchange said that the company would apply for a license with the CFTC in August allowing it to offer prediction markets.

title: Crypto entering biggest consolidation phase in history, says ARK analyst
summary: ARK Invest’s Lorenzo Valente says revenue is becoming increasingly concentrated among a handful of crypto protocols, setting the stage for more mergers, acquisitions and exchange closures.

title: Tennessee county passes another ban on crypto operations
summary: A group of 12 county commissioners voted unanimously to ban mining facilities and data centers in unincorporated areas as it deals with a lawsuit by a digital asset company.

title: US prosecutors propose changes to CLARITY as voting window narrows: Report
summary: A White House crypto adviser said that the proposed changes to the CLARITY Act were “not even close” to the administration’s position, signaling another fight over the bill.

title: Binance launches regulated gold, silver options through ADGM exchange
summary: New commodity options let traders gain exposure to gold and silver prices through Binance’s Abu Dhabi-regulated exchange.
